verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server documented at attio.com/mcp. Attio's docs also advertise connecting Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool to search, update and manage the workspace, which fits a first-party MCP endpoint that agents can connect to. missing for 10: details of the MCP tool set, auth/setup steps and supported clients, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the connection working.
